description: Permanently remove an organization member. This action is IRREVERSIBLE — the user must be re-invited to rejoin. Returns a preview; re-call with the confirm_token and an idempotency_key to commit.

confirm_token.description: Token returned by the preview (call this tool once with no token to get it). Required to commit; expires in ~10 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Required when committing (confirm_token present): retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

org_user_id.description: Id of the OrganizationUser record to remove (not the Firebase userId).

name: remove_user
